title: When the Wreck Sings
author: Casper Brightwater
blurb: Casper Joubert, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, has spent twenty years measuring life in miles rather than years. But when the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
